lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters distributed across the mid-flank with a semi-regular spatial frequency.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with the lateral spots to form a series of grid-like nodes across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient consisting of a light dorsal edge and shadowed ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A white, elongated feature or lesion is visible near the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
